purpose: Contrast pairs: the same scene twice, once biting the sofa (a = positive) and once a look-alike that is not (b = negative). Teaches the difference between 'dog at the sofa chewing something' and 'dog chewing the sofa'.
how_to_use: Save as P01a.mp4, P01b.mp4 … P10b.mp4 in data/Pairs-Videos (id only, labeling stays blind).
Best: generate each pair from the same starting image (image-to-video) or the same seed, so only the action differs.
Keep both clips of a pair in the same train/test split when evaluating (they share a scene).
Label what is visible; generators sometimes swap the action.
